segments.text: A CEO makes a personal mistake in shareholders pay. A government mismanages its currencies. and its savers pay. Bitcoin's rules aren't kept by a single executive or a single central bank. They're enforced by thousands of independent computers running the same code. No CEO, no compromise, no committee to debate.
